snippet.title: A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and..
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5109940

A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong.

A comedy quiz game inspired by old flash classics like The Impossible Quiz

Wishlist on Steam now, link in bio!
